## How to test

- [ ] `make lint-fix` then `make ci` (or `make all` for coverage + complexity)
- [ ] `make security` (if your change touches deps, Docker, or security-sensitive paths)
- [ ] Manual verification (if applicable)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR targets **`develop`** (not `main`, except release merges)
- [ ] Scope is focused and documented
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
- [ ] README/docs updated when behavior changed
